title: How One 'If-Then' Sentence Doubled Follow-Through in Labs
alt_title_2: Why Specifying Time and Place Beats Motivation Speeches
description_hook: Psychologist Peter Gollwitzer introduced Implementation Intentions in 1999. In a 2002 British Journal of Health Psychology trial by Milne, Orbell, and Sheeran, adding one written 'When and Where' plan lifted exercise follow-through from 38% to 91%.

affiliate_cta.offer_name: If-Then Execution Card + Behavioral Habit Reading List

scenes.headline: 38% vs 91% Follow-Through From One Sentence
scenes.stat_label: SAME GOAL, RADICALLY DIFFERENT EXECUTION RATE
bullets: Control group stayed stuck at 38% completion
One written If-Then trigger pushed action to 91%
scenes.narration: How did one group of British students jump from thirty-eight percent exercise follow-through to ninety-one percent? One written If-Then sentence.
scenes.source: Milne, Orbell & Sheeran, British Journal of Health Psychology (2002)

scenes.headline: Gollwitzer (1999) & Milne, Orbell, Sheeran (2002)
bullets: Health-risk pep talks alone added zero follow-through
Specifying exact day, time, and gym hit 91%
scenes.narration: Psychologist Peter Gollwitzer formalized Implementation Intentions in 1999. Testing it in 2002, Sarah Milne, Sheina Orbell, and Paschal Sheeran found scary health warnings alone stayed stuck at thirty-five percent, while specifying exact time and place hit ninety-one.
scenes.source: Gollwitzer, American Psychologist (1999); Milne, Orbell & Sheeran (2002)

scenes.headline: Vague Wishes Collapse When You Feel Tired
scenes.left_body: 'I will work on my side business this weekend' -> 38% odds
scenes.right_body: 'If 7 AM Saturday at desk -> draft script for 90m' -> 91% odds
scenes.narration: Vague goals like 'save more' or 'build this weekend' collapse at five PM because a tired brain has to negotiate when and where.

scenes.headline: Pre-Code Your Cue Before Going to Sleep
scenes.stat_label: ENVIRONMENTAL CUES BYPASS REAL-TIME WILLPOWER TAX
scenes.narration: Pre-load the cue tonight using Gollwitzer's exact syntax: 'If it is seven AM Saturday at my desk, then I immediately draft for ninety minutes.'

scenes.headline: Fire Before Your Excuses Wake Up
bullets: Never leave tomorrow's deep block unscheduled
Bind every core habit to a clock and a chair
scenes.narration: Delegate the starting pistol to a concrete time and place so action fires before excuses wake up.
scenes.source: Mind & Margin protocol based on Gollwitzer (1999) & Milne et al. (2002)
